subject: HorizonPay SIG assessment: request for penetration artifacts, scope clarifications, and remediation status
messages:
From: Olivia Reyes <olivia.reyes@horizonpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@horizonpay.com>, security@horizonpay.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for SIG assessment

Hi Hannah,

We're working through HorizonPay's SIG intake and our security review flagged a few items where we need artifacts to complete verification. Can you help provide the following for Redwood?

- Latest penetration test report (full report, redacted where necessary)
- Inventory of open findings with severity, owner, and remediation ETA
- Evidence for control mapping (SOC2 control IDs, test artifacts, screenshots, logs)
- Updated asset inventory and high-level architecture diagram
- Any scope clarifications (third-party, staging environments, or excluded hosts)

If possible, we'd like the packet by EOD Tue (2027-04-13) to keep our audit timeline. If there are restrictions on sharing full reports, please indicate what we can receive instead.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olivia Reyes
Senior InfoSec Manager, HorizonPay
olivia.reyes@horizonpay.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for SIG assessment

Folks — forwarding HorizonPay's request. They need the pen test packet + remediation status and a clear scope note by EOD Tue 4/13. Key asks are in Olivia's message below.

Quick asks:
- Monica: can you own the delivery and decide redaction policy?
- Karthik: pull latest PT report and the evidence bundle (logs/screenshots, artifact list).
- Evelyn: update remediation_tracker.csv with owners and ETAs, and coordinate with Eng (Jonas) for any outstanding code fixes.
- Jonas: available to validate technical owner updates and confirm whether any items are blocked by 3rd-party dependencies.

If we can't meet EOD Tue with everything, propose a staging plan (e.g., deliver redacted report + tracker first, then full evidence under NDA).

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test artifacts and remediation status for SIG assessment

Thanks Hannah. I'll coordinate delivery and handle the redaction questions with legal if needed. Plan:

1) Karthik — please pull the most recent penetration test report (internal copy) and produce a redacted PDF for external delivery (filename: Redwood_PT_Report_2026-11.pdf). Also assemble an evidence_bundle_2027-04-12.zip with sampled logs, screenshots, and the signed scope statement — put in the shared drive link below.

2) Evelyn — update remediation_tracker_2027-04.csv with current status, severity, owner, and ETA for all open findings. Highlight any findings that are waiting on third-party fixes.

3) Jonas — review the tracker updates and confirm technical owners; also flag any items where we can't provide raw logs for privacy/regulatory reasons.

Deadline: deliver redacted report + remediation tracker to Hannah by Mon 4/12 COB so Hannah can send an initial packet to HorizonPay Monday evening PST. Full evidence bundle can follow on Tue 4/13 under secure link (Drive share restricted).

Attachments (placeholders): evidence_manifest_2027-04.txt
Shared workspace: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_folder
JIRA ticket: SEC-4827 (for internal tracking)

Monica Patel
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00

Quick update — I pulled the internal PT report and started preparing the redacted version. Uploaded the following to the shared Drive (see link):

- Redwood_PT_Report_2026-11_internal.pdf (internal copy)
- Redwood_PT_Report_2026-11.pdf (redacted external copy)
- evidence_bundle_2027-04-12.zip (sampled logs, screenshots, signed scope statement)
- asset_inventory_2027-04.xlsx (export from CMDB)

Note: one medium finding references a 3rd-party library (payment-gateway SDK) that is within HorizonPay's integration scope; we should call that out in scope clarifications to avoid ownership confusion.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_folder

I'll confirm hashes for the zipped evidence and attach the evidence_manifest_2027-04.txt to the final packet. Expect the redacted PT PDF + remediation tracker by COB today (Mon 4/12). Full evidence bundle will be shared under restricted permissions Tue 4/13 as planned.

Thanks — Karthik

Best,
